## ⚠️ IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTICE ⚠️
**If this is a critical security vulnerability that could be exploited, please:**
1. **DO NOT** post details in this public issue
2. Email the details privately to [your-security-email@domain.com]
3. Wait for acknowledgment before any public disclosure

For non-critical security improvements or hardening suggestions, you may use this template.
